guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：霍恩西離岸風電場
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm
guides.concept: 以大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護解析霍恩西離岸風電場：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm through large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hornsea2風資源。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識陣列blade載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識風機與海上集電。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識基礎與海況模態。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識尾流與出口海纜。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海上可達窗口。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify hornsea-2 wind resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify array blade loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbines/offshore collection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify foundations/sea-state modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify wakes/export cables in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify offshore access windows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交尾流與出口海纜的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交海上可達窗口的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wakes/export cables.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for offshore access windows.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

related.title: Hywind Tampen 浮式風電
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護；Hywind Tampen 浮式風電改以浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service; Hywind Tampen floating wind centers on floating concrete supports and platform electricity, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Hornsea2風資源與Tampen風資源，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare hornsea-2 wind resources with tampen wind resources and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Hywind Tampen floating wind, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from offshore access windows and propose an observation distinguishing large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service from floating concrete supports and platform electricity, including uncertainty.
